title: Senator Rand Paul highlights Secure America Act signing and children's health advocacy
text:
Senator Rand Paul, chair of the Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs, shared updates on June 10, 2026, regarding his legislative activities and advocacy efforts. Through a series of posts on his official X account, Paul highlighted his involvement in the passage of border security legislation and participation in an event focused on children’s health.
In a post published at 15:38 UTC, Paul wrote: “It’s a good thing to have Rand! He knows what’s important!” – @POTUS
It’s an honor to stand with President Trump & fellow Republicans as we sign the Secure America Act into law.
Proud to have led the charge in Congress to secure funding for the border.
cc: @WhiteHouse https://t.co/NtiNjVNjfk
Later that morning at 17:03 UTC, he added, Great morning with @POTUS. Glad to see this important legislation moving forward to protect our border. https://t.co/dJWU0Y2DxY .
Paul also participated in Children’s Hospital Day Advocacy Day events. At 20:19 UTC, he posted, I had the pleasure of making remarks for @ChildrensHD Advocacy Day. Making America Healthy Again for our kids and future generations is one of my top priorities.
Famous actor Rob Schneider also attended! https://t.co/aWYp4b9ylh
According to Paul’s official website, he performs pro-bono eye surgeries for patients both in Kentucky and abroad during international medical missions ( source ). He holds a medical degree from Duke University School of Medicine and works as an ophthalmologist who founded the Southern Kentucky Lions Eye Clinic. In addition to his legislative duties, Paul assists Kentucky residents with federal government agency matters.
The Secure America Act referenced by Paul is part of ongoing efforts by congressional Republicans and President Trump’s administration to address border security concerns.
